SP May Excited to Play for Minnesota
The Minnesota front office announced the signing of <Dustin May:player#20077> today as the team's new starting pitcher. The 29-year-old came to terms with the <Twins:team#17> and will be hauling in $11,400,000 a year over 3 years.

In career numbers, <May:player#20077> has registered a 23-34 record with a 4.24 ERA.
